project_context.name: KHALABA
project_context.domain: Maternal & Infant Health Web Application (Sub-Saharan Africa)

core_principles: Warm & Empathetic: Avoid sterile clinical blue/white themes. Healthcare must feel approachable, human, and rooted in the community.
Field-Ready Legibility: UI must be extremely clear on mobile devices in variable lighting. High contrast for text, generous touch targets.
Cultural Resonance: Subtle nods to African earth tones and textures without falling into caricature.
Information Hierarchy: Complex medical data (CPN forms, postnatal tracking) must be chunked into manageable, clearly separated cards.

primary.description: Terracotta - Represents the earth, warmth, and life. Used for primary CTAs and active states.

secondary.description: Soft Ochre - Used for secondary actions, subtle highlights, and supportive UI elements.

accent.description: Luminous Gold - Used sparingly for key alerts, important notifications, or to draw attention to critical metrics.

background.description: Sand Beige - The main app background. Provides a warm, calming base instead of stark white.

surface.description: Pure white for cards and form containers to ensure maximum contrast and readability against the Sand Beige background.

text.description: Deep Chocolate for primary text (avoids the harshness of pure black). Lighter brown for muted/secondary text.

hierarchy.h1: font-heading text-4xl sm:text-5xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-[#3E2723]
hierarchy.h2: font-heading text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-medium tracking-tight text-[#3E2723]
hierarchy.small: font-body text-sm font-medium text-[#795C55] uppercase tracking-[0.05em]

rules: Do NOT use Inter or standard system fonts for headings.
Ensure all text has a minimum contrast ratio of 4.5:1 against its background.

layout_and_spacing.strategy: Mobile-first, generous spacing for readability in the field.

buttons.primary: bg-[#C85A48] hover:bg-[#B34D3D] text-white rounded-xl px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-colors shadow-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-[#D99A5A]/20 hover:bg-[#D99A5A]/30 text-[#3E2723] rounded-xl px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-colors
buttons.outline: border-2 border-[#C85A48] text-[#C85A48] hover:bg-[#C85A48]/5 rounded-xl px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-colors
buttons.touch_target: MUST be at least 48px height on mobile for field workers.

cards.style: bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(62,39,35,0.05)] border border-[#3E2723]/5 p-6
cards.usage: Use for dashboard widgets, patient summary blocks, and wrapping form sections.

forms.inputs: bg-[#F7F3EB]/50 border border-[#3E2723]/10 text-[#3E2723] rounded-xl px-4 py-3 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#C85A48]/50 focus:border-[#C85A48] transition-all
forms.structure: Group related fields (e.g., Constantes Cliniques, Bilans Biologiques) into distinct card-like sections to reduce cognitive load for health workers.

navigation.style: bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-[#3E2723]/10 sticky top-0 z-50

charts.style: Remove default Recharts grid lines or make them extremely faint. Use rounded corners on bar charts.

icons.style: Use strokeWidth={2}. For a warmer feel, use icons that represent human connection rather than generic tech where possible.

hero_mother_baby.description: Smiling baby being bathed, conveying health, warmth, and care. Use in the landing page hero section.
hero_mother_baby.overlay: bg-gradient-to-r from-[#F7F3EB]/90 to-[#F7F3EB]/40 for text contrast.

midwife_doctor_1.description: Smiling African female doctor/midwife holding stethoscope. Use for the 'Healthcare Professional' portal login or features section.

midwife_doctor_2.description: Doctor consulting with a patient. Use in about us or value proposition section.

abstract_texture.description: Rusty terracotta texture. Can be used as a very subtle, low-opacity (opacity-5) background pattern for specific highlight sections or login screens.

testing.attributes: ALL interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs, tabs) MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Tailwind CSS for all styling. Rely on the custom colors defined in this JSON.
Implement the Layout and Spacing strictly. Do not use raw HTML forms without styling; wrap them in Shadcn components customized with the 'forms' and 'inputs' classes above.
Implement mobile-first responsive design as health workers will use this on mobile devices.
Do NOT use placeholder images. Use the Unsplash/Pexels URLs provided in the media section.
For the dashboards, use Recharts and apply the custom color palette provided.

The logo concept: Create a custom SVG logo using the letter 'K' creatively structured like a mother cradling a child, featuring a Luminous Gold (#F2C94C) radiating heart at the center, as specified in the investment dossier.
Ensure French language is used for all UI text (e.g., 'Connexion', 'Tableau de bord', 'Dossier Patient', 'Constantes Cliniques').
Provide clear feedback (toasts/alerts) on form submission for the CPN and MPDSR forms.
Since the codebase uses .js files, ensure all React components and configurations are written in JavaScript (ES6+), not TypeScript.
